overall: Los Angeles is starting the day cool and foggy at 64°F (running max 66.2°F as of early morning), consistent with a marine layer that the NWS expects to clear by 11am. Once the fog lifts, mostly sunny skies should allow temperatures to climb toward the mid-70s, though the onshore flow and morning cloudiness will cap the heating potential. The Heat Advisory in effect covers inland and mountain areas well north of LA proper, not the coastal basin, so it is not a major direct driver for today's downtown/coastal high.
forecast_obs_notes: There is notable model spread: ECMWF (72.1°F) and NBM (70.6°F) cluster near the NWS official call of 72°F, while GFS (75.5°F) and HRRR (76.3°F) run 3-4°F warmer. The META fused model, concentrating 46.7% probability in the 72-73°F bucket, aligns closely with ECMWF and NWS, lending confidence to the lower end of the spread.
